title: Scanner promotes exact hosts entries to suffix blocks
reproduction: Call scan_list_for_critical with only '0.0.0.0 whatsapp.net\n'. The embedded offline reproduction in tooling-audit-review.md invokes the actual functions without network.
expected: Only whatsapp.net is blocked by this exact hosts entry; suffix matching is reserved for formats with suffix semantics.
observed: Seven domains are reported blocked, including mmg.whatsapp.net and static.whatsapp.net. extract_blocked_domains loses the rule kind and domain_is_blocked applies parent matching to every entry.
fix: Retain exact versus suffix kind through extraction and report merging; match hosts/plain domains exactly and only supported suffix rules by DNS label boundary.
test_evidence: Reproduced locally: one hosts entry yields seven hits. Direct-host, unrelated-domain and ABP positive controls pass. Regression plan: exact parent must not hit child; supported suffix rule must hit child but not a non-label suffix. No Android/runtime behavior execution.

title: Scanner silently misses valid hosts aliases and mixed-format entries
reproduction: Run actual scan_list_for_critical on five fixtures: 0.0.0.0 alias; 127.0.0.1 alias; ::1 host; indented IPv4 host; one unrelated hosts row followed by a plain critical domain. Exact fixture text is embedded in the review.
expected: mmg.whatsapp.net is recognized in all five forms accepted by the app hosts parser; reports must not classify these lists as clean.
observed: All five fixtures produce no critical hits. The regex takes only the first host, excludes IPv6/leading whitespace, and one hosts row disables all plain-domain parsing.
fix: Parse each line independently; handle whitespace, comments, accepted IP forms and every hosts alias; preserve supported plain-domain lines within mixed input.
test_evidence: Five offline actual-function assertions reproduced empty hits, with ordinary IPv4 positive control. Clean SourceLoader.java:583-635 was inspected as contextual evidence only. Regression plan: require the critical alias/domain in all fixtures plus comment/localhost/unrelated negatives.

title: Scanner recommends unblocking domains it classifies as ads or telemetry
reproduction: Mock one downloaded list containing only ads.telegram.org and crashlogs.whatsapp.net, clear historical known results, capture all open(...,'w') calls in StringIO, and run actual main.
expected: No compatibility allowlist additions for explicitly NONE/LOW telemetry-only hits; retain ad/tracker blocks and recommend only justified exact compatibility hosts.
observed: high_risk_lists is empty, but recommendations contain ads.telegram.org, crashlogs.whatsapp.net, *.telegram.org and *.whatsapp.net. Markdown also tells users to add all unprotected domains.
fix: Filter recommendations by positive compatibility impact, keep ads/telemetry excluded, and remove unconditional parent/wildcard expansion. Treat any broad unblock as a separate explicitly reviewed decision.
test_evidence: Actual main reproduced the contradiction with three output files captured solely in memory and urlopen blocked. Regression plan: telemetry-only fixture yields no additions; a real high-impact host yields only that exact host and still excludes sibling tracking domains.

title: Certificate helper deletes unrelated caller-directory files before validation
reproduction: Static reproduction: the first command is rm localhost.*; glob-match localhost.backup and localhost.notes. From repository root ssl.conf is absent although Resources/certificate/ssl.conf exists. Do not execute the original against real data.
expected: Only explicitly selected certificate outputs may be replaced after configuration/tool success; caller working directory and unrelated localhost.* files remain untouched.
observed: An unqualified broad removal runs first in the caller directory. OpenSSL then resolves ssl.conf from that same directory, so a root-directory invocation can delete matching files and fail to generate replacements.
fix: Anchor inputs and outputs to an explicit directory; validate prerequisites; generate replacements before replacing exact output names; remove the broad preemptive deletion.
test_evidence: bash -n passed and local fnmatch assertions confirmed matching .backup/.notes as well as .crt/.key. No deletion helper or OpenSSL executed. Regression plan: mocked command trace from foreign CWD and generation-failure cases must preserve originals and unrelated files.

title: Both translation configurations reference four removed source resources
reproduction: Parse all source_file entries in both configurations and test local existence. Missing: values/strings_support.xml and raw/help_faq.html, raw/help_problems.html, raw/help_s_on_s_off.html under app/src/main/res/.
expected: Every configured source resource exists, or a retired resource is explicitly removed from both sync configurations.
observed: Both independent configurations contain 23 resources and the same four absent source paths; those source entries cannot be read for translation sync.
fix: Remove retired resources or point to their intended maintained replacements in both configurations; keep the CLI and GitHub mappings synchronized.
test_evidence: Ruby YAML and Python ConfigParser each found exactly four missing sources; no Transifex request or source content from dirty files read. Regression plan: local guard requires all configured source paths to exist and both source-resource sets to match; service execution remains untested.

title: Contributor quickstart invokes a release build without required trust inputs
reproduction: Follow the documented fresh-contributor sequence with SDK configured but without signingStoreLocation/signingStorePassword/signingKeyAlias/signingKeyPassword/updateManifestPublicKeyBase64/releaseSigningCertificateSha256. The final command is ./gradlew assembleRelease.
expected: The basic contributor quickstart builds using a debug key; production release instructions explicitly supply or link the mandatory trust inputs.
observed: app/build.gradle:80-127 recognizes assembleRelease as a release request and throws when signing properties are absent, then requires the update key and signer hash. The quickstart provides none.
fix: Use assembleDebug for first-run contributor instructions and link the maintained release guide for signed release builds; do not weaken the build trust checks.
test_evidence: Source-path proof and local guard predicate check only; Gradle was not invoked. Regression plan: documentation guard checks debug-first command and release-guide link; a separate authorized clean-home build can validate the documented setup.
